limitations: The old Docker stabilization endpoints on 55432/56379 did not respond (read-only database connection timed out and Docker ps remained pending). Their auth-lifecycle/rate-limit suites were not run in this checkpoint; the new narrow auth-entry suite ran against the verified Espresso regression DB. No isolation guard was bypassed.

No live SMTP delivery, new account credentials or password changes are performed through the browser. Those actions are outside the browser replay; existing credential sign-in is exercised using synthetic fixture accounts.

The valid invitation acceptance form is covered by component tests; its successful account-creation path and all signup modes have not been replayed end to end in this browser checkpoint. In-review status does not imply final acceptance.
This is an authentication route-family checkpoint, not completion or acceptance of all 97 routes.
